reproduction.description: Compares actual likelihood trajectories from identical initialization, accepted extrapolation factors and fitted mixture densities.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
400 synthetic scalar observations and two components replace 5,000 observations in 15 dimensions and K=5/10.
Maximum-likelihood fitting with variance floor 1e-6, no original default priors; growth factors 1.5 and 2, capped η=16.
Safeguard requires an extrapolation to beat the ordinary M-step; original only requires improvement over the previous iterate. No timing claims.
